content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler Juice, Mixed Fruit is a 100 % natural fruit juice specially formulated for children from 1 year old. It blends apple, pear, banana and berries, without added sugar or preservatives.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The juice is made from carefully selected fruits grown without pesticides.
Each bottle contains about 120 ml, an ideal portion size for toddlers.
It provides approximately 15 mg of vitamin C to support immunity.
The product meets strict quality standards and complies with Russian GOST for baby foods.
Packaging is made from safe PET material that is recyclable.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C from the fruit blend helps protect the body against common colds.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Natural fruit sugars give a quick source of energy needed by active toddlers.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: A modest amount of fiber aids regular digestion.

items.title: Rich in vitamins
items.content: The juice supplies vitamins A, B6 and folate, important for growth and development.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The liquid content helps maintain proper hydration in young children.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: Children with known allergies to apples, pears or berries should consult a pediatrician before consumption.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, natural fruit sugars may affect blood glucose levels in diabetic children.

items.title: Not suitable for infants under 1 year
items.content: The juice can pose a choking risk and stress the kidneys of infants.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the juice chilled in small portions (30–60 ml) after meals. Do not keep opened juice at room temperature for more than 24 hours.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep it refrigerated and consume within 2‑3 days.
